BIO-02.reason: This combines root-cause and whole-body aging ambitions overlapping LON-02/LON-01. No distinct component mechanism justifies a complete-goal-to-complete-goal arrow.

BIO-03.reason: A reconstruction of later cell evolution is not an implementation of prebiotic abiogenesis; no independent downstream construction was identified.

BIO-06.reason: Its molecular memory goal overlaps NEU-03’s atomic-to-circuit engram ambition. Keep the distinction of scope without asserting one complete account causes the other.

BIO-08.reason: The selective history of sexual reproduction does not supply a specific capability or intervention in another source milestone.

BIO-09.reason: The subjective-experience target overlaps NEU-01 and ZOO-06 rather than specifying a separate causal component.

BIO-10.reason: The conserved adult regeneration pathway substantially overlaps BME-01 and ZOO-05. No independent intervening mechanism is specified between those complete goals.

GEN-01.reason: The historical selection of a codon mapping is not itself a method for constructing a protocell; precursor, replication and translation mechanisms are unspecified.

GEN-03.reason: Stable acquired-trait inheritance in mammals is not the same as plant memory or adult epigenetic resetting. No qualified inheritance-to-intervention route was identified.

GEN-04.reason: Explaining genome-size variation does not give a read-assembly algorithm or a defined engineering intervention.

GEN-07.reason: The source asks for suppression mechanisms but gives no qualified deployment or control route. Genomic stability is not automatically a safe editing platform.

BOT-01.reason: A historical radiation explanation does not establish intrinsic reproductive incompatibility or a crop-design procedure.

BOT-09.reason: A transferable trap program does not provide the non-GM, broad-spectrum defense required by AGR-04; a specific safe application mechanism is unreviewed.

AGR-09.reason: The phenotype does not specify an ion-transport or developmental intervention that could be mapped into another target. Generic climate-resilience containment is not a causal link.

ZOO-01.reason: The listed biological navigation uses external cues; it does not establish the signal-independent, indefinite inertial accuracy required by AER-09.

ZOO-03.reason: The source leaves epigenetic, genetic and cultural explanations open. A mechanism cannot be assigned to mammalian inheritance or navigation hardware by assumption.

ZOO-04.reason: An evolutionary explanation of reproductive lifespan does not specify a qualified fertility or rejuvenation treatment.

ZOO-06.reason: The across-phyla consciousness goal overlaps BIO-09/NEU-01. No separate intervention or required subcapability is specified.

ZOO-07.reason: Eusocial evolution does not provide a defined robotic role-allocation algorithm; the local coordination route is separately represented by ZOO-02.

ZOO-10.reason: The entry groups several unknown functions without a shared identified mechanism, so no specific engineering use is inferred.

MIC-05.reason: A proposed persistence switch needs a qualified pathogen-specific treatment route before a full infection outcome can be inferred.

MIC-06.reason: Forecasting gene transfer does not itself suppress resistance or specify a treatment/containment policy; no such intervention was supplied.

MIC-07.reason: The unknown lineage and chemistry cannot be assigned useful membranes, enzymes or energy capabilities before discovery.

MIC-09.reason: Dormancy and necromass mechanisms do not directly establish stable soil carbon or treatment outcomes without a specific state-control intervention.

VIR-01.reason: Alternative historical origin hypotheses do not themselves supply a protocell, antiviral or engineering method.

VIR-02.reason: A conserved antiviral target needs a particular molecular intervention and reservoir model before connecting to a durable universal cure; no unqualified cure arrow was added.

VIR-05.reason: No particular persistent-virus pathway is assumed causal in a listed chronic disease. Condition-specific intervention and causal evidence are still needed.

VIR-06.reason: The atlas scope overlaps MIC-04. Keep both original virome goals without an atlas-to-atlas causal arrow.

VIR-08.reason: Historical viral contributions to later eukaryotic traits do not specify the earlier endosymbiotic mechanism in BIO-03 or a qualified gene-control device.

VIR-10.reason: An unknown infectious chemistry cannot be assigned a diagnostic or treatment mechanism in advance.

IMM-07.reason: Mapping neuro-immune communication does not identify a specific safe intervention or the cause of a particular brain/immune disorder.

NEU-01.reason: The hard-problem target overlaps BIO-09’s subjective-substrate goal. It is not asserted necessary for anesthesia, neural coding or interface engineering.

NEU-06.reason: A full account of semantic meaning does not specify a measurable decoder or interface algorithm; a generic neuroscience-to-AI arrow was rejected.

NEU-07.reason: The target is an unresolved causal/philosophical account, not a defined control or computational mechanism for another capability.

NEU-08.reason: A qualified intervention route to a clinical anesthesia target is not specified by this conceptual mechanism alone in this batch.

LON-06.reason: The source description overlaps ZOO-08’s comparative senescence mechanisms; an additional intervention is not defined, so no goal-to-goal prerequisite is drawn.

rejectedCandidates.reason: External biological cues do not establish indefinite signal-free navigation.
Transferable carnivory programs do not establish the source’s non-GM requirement or universal pest resistance.
Later eukaryotic reconstruction is not a prebiotic protocell construction method.
